body: a plump round white rabbit shaped like a soft rice cake, wider than tall, crouching low on the ground with tiny front paws tucked under its chin and a big fluffy round tail at the back. Two tall pointed ears stand straight up from its head, made of pale blue translucent crystal with flat faceted faces. A few small pale blue crystal shards grow out of the back of its head and out of its back, all pointing backward. The fur is soft white with faint pale blue shading.
stance: It crouches low on the ground on four short legs, belly almost touching the ground,
front: two round dark dot eyes set wide apart, a tiny simple smile, and two round pink cheek marks

back: the plain back of the rabbit: no eyes and no mouth at all, only the big fluffy round tail in the middle, the crystal shards on the back pointing at the viewer, and the two crystal ears seen from behind
